name: mindbody
description: Run a studio's Mindbody business software from your AI agent in your own Chrome: schedules, rosters, bookings, client status, sales, attendance and reports.

interface.shortDescription: Run your studio's Mindbody site from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Works in Mindbody's business site in your own browser, signed in as you: today's schedule and rosters, booking and cancelling with a preview first, membership and balance checks, notes, sales, attendance and top members, intro offers and lapsed members. Asks before anything that moves money.
defaultPrompt: What's on the class schedule today in Mindbody?
Who were our top members by check-ins last month?
